<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead" summary="Task #3 시작: dynamic-indexer HTTPRoute 작성">
Task #3(HTTPRoute 템플릿 작성) - dynamic-indexer를 담당해주세요.

## 작업 내용
search-admin의 기존 httproute.yaml 템플릿을 레퍼런스로, dynamic-indexer에 httproute.yaml을 생성하세요.

### 담당 서비스 (devops-2)
- **dynamic-indexer** (`apps/next-search/dynamic-indexer/templates/httproute.yaml`)

### 추가 작업
- 4개 서비스 모두의 values.yaml에 httpRoute 기본값 블록 추가
- 환경별 values 파일(values-dev.yaml, values-prod.yaml)에 httpRoute 설정 예시 추가

### 레퍼런스 파일
- `apps/next-search/search-admin/templates/httproute.yaml`

### 핵심 포인트
1. search-admin 패턴 그대로 적용, _helpers.tpl include 함수명만 변경
2. backendRefs port: 8080 (dynamic-indexer 서비스 포트)
3. values.yaml에 httpRoute 기본값: enabled: false
4. values-dev.yaml 예시: parentRefs에 Gateway 참조, hostnames에 dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer-api.danuricorp.com

devops-1이 search-api, legacy-sync를 담당합니다. 완료되면 team-lead에게 보고해주세요.
</teammate-message>

image:
  pullPolicy: Always
  tag: "1.0224.85"

nameOverride: "dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer"
fullnameOverride: "dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer"
otelServiceName: "development.dev-search.dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer"

envFrom:
  # 서비스 특화 ConfigMap 참조
  - configMapRef:
      name: dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer-config
  # secret 참조
  - secretRef:
      name: "dev-cmn-search-credentials"

# 서비스 특화 ConfigMap 설정
config:
  profile: dev

  # application envs
  index:
    adminCatalog: catalogs
    adminProduct: products
    appProduct: products
    appCatalog: catalogs

  # outbound envs
  client:
    proxyApi:
      baseUrl: "dev-shopping-internal.danuricorp.com/graphql"

  kafka:
    catalogCdc:
      enabled: true
      bootstrapServers: "kafka-cluster-kafka-bootstrap.cmn-cdc-dev.svc.cluster.local:9092"
      topic: "cmn.pricecompare-be-team.cdc.mongo.shopping.catalogs.v1"
      groupId: "cmn-search-team-group-dynamic-indexer"
      concurrency: 5
      properties:
        autoOffsetReset: latest
        enableAutoCommit: false
        maxPollRecords: 1000
        fetchMaxWaitMs: 1000
        fetchMinSize: 1
        sessionTimeoutMs: 30000
        schemaRegistryUrl: "http://schema-registry-app.cmn-cdc-dev.svc.cluster.local:8081"
        specificAvroReader: true
        heartbeatIntervalMs: 10000
        securityProtocol: "SASL_PLAINTEXT"
        saslMechanism: "SCRAM-SHA-512"
    productCdc:
      enabled: true
      bootstrapServers: "kafka-cluster-kafka-bootstrap.cmn-cdc-dev.svc.cluster.local:9092"
      topic: "cmn.pricecompare-be-team.cdc.mongo.shopping.products.v1"
      groupId: "cmn-search-team-group-dynamic-indexer"
      concurrency: 10
      properties:
        autoOffsetReset: latest
        enableAutoCommit: false
        maxPollRecords: 1000
        fetchMaxWaitMs: 1000
        fetchMinSize: 1
        sessionTimeoutMs: 30000
        schemaRegistryUrl: "http://schema-registry-app.cmn-cdc-dev.svc.cluster.local:8081"
        specificAvroReader: true
        heartbeatIntervalMs: 10000
        securityProtocol: "SASL_PLAINTEXT"
        saslMechanism: "SCRAM-SHA-512"

  dynamicIndexerAdmin:
    broadcastTopic: "cmn-search-team.search.dynamic-indexer.broadcast"

  elasticsearch:
    urls: "http://dev-cmn-es-http:9200"
    connectionTimeout: "5000"
    socketTimeout: "5000"

  valkey:
    backend:
      hosts: "dev-cmn-infra-valkey-cluster-headless.cmn-infra.svc.cluster.local:6379"
      database: "0"
      maxRedirects: 5
      commandSeconds: 10

ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: "nginx"
  annotations: { }
  hosts:
    - host: dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer-api.danuricorp.com
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: Prefix
          port: 8080
  tls: []

resources:
  limits:
    memory: 2Gi
    cpu: 2
  requests:
    memory: 2Gi
    cpu: 2

replicaCount: 2

autoscaling:
  enabled: false

podAnnotations:
  grafana.danuricorp.com/app: development.dev-search.dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer
  prometheus.io/interval: 30s
